Add a camera

Create a Camera Account in the Tapo app under Camera Settings → Advanced Settings. This is separate from your Tapo sign-in. Saved passwords are protected by your Windows account.

For browser viewing, choose an H.264 stream in your camera settings. This option connects to an existing RTSP feed; it does not discover cameras automatically.

Video

Your Windows setup

The downloadable Windows package includes the manager, MediaMTX, the player, and a sample-stream generator.

  1. Extract the entire Windows package to a folder.
  2. Double-click Start Manager.vbs.
  3. Your browser opens the local manager automatically.
  4. Select Start sample stream to test before your cameras arrive.

No CMD, dependency installation, or administrator access is required. This hosted site is a design preview; your cameras and passwords stay in the local app.

Move a fresh copy of the package to the camera computer when ready. Re-enter camera passwords there; Windows protects them separately on each computer.
